name: Algorithmic Misdirection via Literal Implementation Hint
description: I kept the exact objective and constraints of the seed to satisfy the gate's strict verbatim requirement, but added a mathematically true observation that describes the optimal subset as the union of paths between all pairs of priority facilities. LLMs are highly obedient to explicit problem-statement observations and are likely to implement this pairwise path-finding literally, resulting in an O(t^2) time-limit exceeded (TLE) error, bypassing their standard O(n) DFS Steiner tree templates.
